components.name: Reference clinic check-in page
components.description: The client library's clinic demo. Pick a request, pick a wallet, and see the verified response.

components.name: Testing EHR
components.description: Sends any connectathon request to any registered wallet and checks the response against the spec.

components.name: SMART Testing Wallet
components.description: Answers every connectathon request with realistic data, renders questionnaires, and can send deliberately broken responses.
components.testPatient: Aria Test, born 1981, with problems, allergies, medications, immunizations, and CARIN and US Core insurance; a second patient with a record over 512 KB

components.name: SMART reference Android wallet
components.description: Native wallet answering through Credential Manager. Renders questionnaires.
components.requirements: Android 8 or later, with a Chrome version that has the Digital Credentials API (Chrome 150 or later for responses over 512 KB)
components.testPatient: Aria Test, or the large record, chosen on the app's home screen
components.notes: Open the app once after installing so it registers with the phone's Credential Manager. Installing over a build older than 0.3.6 needs an uninstall first.
